about_the_game:
Demo available in 4 languages! (한국어/English/简体中文/日本語)

All men have been wiped from the Earth. It marks the dawn of a new world.
Only women remain in this post-apocalyptic world, where a vast and intriguing epic unfolds.

Under the blessing of La, the one true god, men vanished from this world 1,500 years ago.

In this flawless peace, 'Eclipse,' a special forces unit composed of those with supernatural powers, has upheld law and order in the world.

However, with the rise of the new cult 'Apep,' hidden fractures begin to surface.
Haesu, a member of Eclipse, is caught in the whirlwind of a great destiny,
and behind the peace she has always believed in lies a forgotten truth.

At last, the Wheel of Fortune starts to turn.
What choice will Haesu make?

Everything rests in your hands.
Uncover the secrets of the Eclipse world with Haesu and face the hidden truth.

Interactive Visual Novel: Multi-Ending System

The game features branching points based on the player's choices, allowing them to experience various events and endings while progressing through the story.

Your choices will shape the direction of the story, and as a result, the protagonist will face different outcomes.

Visual Concept: Manga

The main event scenes of the game are presented in a manga style, allowing players to experience the fun and nostalgia of flipping through a comic book.

A total of 124 stunning illustrations and vibrant, manga-style expressions maximize immersion.

Worldview
#EgyptianMythology #SupernaturalPowers #Military #PostApocalypse

The world of Eclipse is designed with ancient Egyptian mythology as its motif. Immerse yourself in the fascinating epic where supernatural abilities and the military merge in a beautiful post-apocalyptic setting.

Haesu (The protagonist of Eclipse)

“Mhm, alright. Let’s turn this place upside down.”

Member of Eclipse / Nullification of supernatural powers

While Haesu believes she lacks a strong sense of justice, those around her see her differently. Her unwavering urge to help others has earned her the reputation of being a natural "meddler."

While investigating the 'indiscriminate terror incident,' she gets closer to a shocking truth and finds herself at a crossroads…?

Dallae

“I’d rather die than be on the losing end.”

Member of Eclipse / Illusion manipulation

Haesu’s partner, who uncovered the hidden truth behind the indiscriminate terror incident, holds Haesu in special regard due to their unique bond that has lasted since childhood. However, toward others, she remains indifferent and often acts with cruelty.

The Prophet

The commander-in-chief of Eclipse

"My only choice is to sin to survive and lay bare my sins before our great Mother." 

As the only person capable of hearing the voice of La, the creator of all things, she is revered and venerated as the Spokesperson of the Sun God by all.

Villain A

“May god’s blessings be with you.”

The host of an elite-only party, Haesu and Dalle encounter during their undercover investigation. The mask, depicting a goat—a symbol often associated with evil—adds an eerie and unsettling aura to her presence.

Villain B

“There is no point in knowing, You’re going to die anyway.” 

An individual who moves according to A’s orders, with her name, age, past, and everything else shrouded in mystery.

Villain C

“To those of you living fleeting lives… I shall grant an eternity of hell.” 

A figure harboring profound hostility toward Solarism and Eclipse. She leads those around her with her formidable supernatural power, and wherever she treads, only the pitch-black void of death remains.

Game systems and features available for experience in the demo:

You can use all features except for achievements (a total of 59) and the album function and play through a prologue-length segment of the game.

Prologue Length: Overview of Demo Content

- A total of 8 episodes out of the 85 episodes are provided.

- Out of approximately 320,000 characters (including spaces), around 24,000 characters of the script are provided.

- Out of 28 total choices, 4 can be experienced.

- Out of 51 total scenes, 4 scenes are available.

- Out of 124 images, 10 images are provided.

- A total of 59 achievements are available in the main game.

content_descriptors.notes:
A PC visual novel game that follows the story of a member of the special forces unit "Eclipse," who fights against the heretical religious group "Apep" to maintain peace.

Limited Depictions of Violence
(Verbal descriptions and illustrations of violent situations, as well as the depiction of red blood)
(The blood in CG event scenes was mostly depicted in black to lower the intensity, while the blood in short visual effects lasting only a few seconds was rendered in red.)

Moderate Language Use
(Some characters use mild profanity)

Therefore, in accordance with Article 21 of the Act on the Promotion of the Game Industry and Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Game Rating Regulations, the game has been classified as "15 and up."

kgrb.descriptors:
등급 번호: GC-CC-NP-240628-001
등급: 15세 이용가

평화를 지키기 위해 이단 종교 집단 ‘아펩’에 맞서 싸우는 특수부대 ‘이클립스’의 대원이 겪는 이야기를 다룬 PC용 비주얼 노벨 게임

제한적인 폭력성 표현
(폭력적인 상황에 대한 언어적 묘사와 일러스트, 붉은 선혈 표현)

과도하지 않은 언어 표현
(등장인물의 일부 비속어 표현)

따라서 게임산업진흥에 관한 법률 제21조 및 등급분류 규정 제7조제3호에 따라 ‘15세이용가’로 등급분류 결정함.

short_description: Yuri Visual Novel Game ⚜️Eclipse⚜️ A world where all men have disappeared. A utopia ruled by women. For 1,500 years, the elite force Eclipse has safeguarded the world's peace. But with the rise of the new cult ‘Apep’, long-forgotten truths begin to resurface. What fate will you choose?
supported_languages: Korean, Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
